banner: Simulation based on assumptions. Not a prediction or advice.
list.title: Investing ABC
list.subtitle: Short lessons on how money works. One idea at a time.
predict.exact: This one is exact, not an estimate.
fallrise.same: If it rises by only {fall}, you reach
list.how: Work through the rooms in order. Each room has short tasks: a brief explanation, then questions about it. Your progress is saved.
room.label: ROOM
room.tryAgain: Not quite. Try again. The hint can help.
room.invalid: Type just a number. Use a minus sign for a loss.
room.revealed: The answer is {answer}. No points for this one.
room.complete.title: Room completed!
room.complete.skipped: Try the room again to earn the points you skipped.
startearly.assume: Grows at {rate} a year. Saving stops at age {stop}.
lend.intro: One lender lends {amount} to a shop owner. Choose what the shop promises and what happens if it fails.
lend.recovery: Share of the money recovered if the shop fails
bond.face: A bond with a face value of {face}.
bondp.intro: A bond with face value {face}, paying a {coupon} coupon, with {years} years left.
pos.intro: You buy {shares} shares at {price} each: {spent} in total, with a {fee} fee.
scp.summary: After {years} years: simple {simple}, compound {compound}. The gap, {extra}, is interest on interest.
path.intro: Pick a path to see where {amount} could end after one typical year.
path.note: About 2 years in 3 end inside this range. Other years can be better or worse.
basket.intro: You have {total} to spread over businesses in equal slices. One business, or the whole market, takes a hit.
sip.intro: You put {amount} into a fund at the start of each month. The price of one unit changes every month. Drag the prices.
fee.intro: You put {monthly} a month into a fund that earns {gross} a year before fees. Compare two yearly fees.
fee.gap: What the higher fee costs you
etf.intro: You have {amount} to invest. A mutual fund gives you one price for the day: {nav}. An ETF has a price that changes while the market is open. Pick a time.
gold.intro: You buy gold jewellery for {price}. Part of that price is a making charge, not gold. Change the charge and the gold price.
gold.change: Gold price change since you bought
gold.content: Value of the gold in it
gold.breakeven: To get your money back, the gold price must rise by about {rise}.
cash.intro: You hold {amount} in one place and need it as cash. Pick where it is held.
hor.intro: You put {amount} on one path and wait. See where it ends across 500 simulated futures.
hor.loss: Futures ending below what you put in
hor.note: Bad case and good case cover 90 of 100 futures. Simulation, not a prediction.
pyr.intro: A scheme says every member must bring in new members to earn. See how fast the numbers grow.
pyr.recruits: New members each person must bring in
pyr.atLevel: People who must join at this level
pyr.total: People in the scheme so far
